items.title: Arbitrary-P2 displacement interpolation has constant speed

source.edition: Public 290-page PDF, preface dated July 2024, SHA256 639ff16e79f4a32ade9c0595b0ed1d95490eb7e402949168895b6a6194a9c02f
source.anchor: Theorem 7.6 and proof, printed pp.209-210/PDF pp.215-216
source.attribution: Sinho Chewi, Jonathan Niles-Weed and Philippe Rigollet state the arbitrary-P2 Wasserstein geodesic theorem. This is ASTIS's attributed paraphrase and formal proof of its ordered metric-identity component.

items.statement: Let mu0 and mu1 be probability measures on Euclidean space with finite second moments, and let gamma be an optimal quadratic transport plan between them. For pi_t(x,y)=(1-t)x+ty and mu_t=(pi_t)_#gamma, every 0<=s<=t<=1 satisfies W2(mu_s,mu_t)=(t-s)W2(mu0,mu1). ASTIS retains its existing finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel ambient interface. Optimal-plan existence and the remaining geodesic-space conclusions are outside this binding.
assumptions: Both endpoint laws are probability measures with finite second moments; no density or absolute continuity is assumed.
A coupling attaining the quadratic Kantorovich infimum is supplied.
The interpolation is the pushforward of that coupling by the affine point map.
The times are ordered in the unit interval.

obligations.label: Prove the exact ordered-time Wasserstein distance identity for the optimal affine pushforward path.
Construct an optimal quadratic transport plan for arbitrary P2 endpoints.
Package path continuity and existence for every endpoint pair into the full geodesic-space theorem.

bindings.boundary: Exactly the ordered metric identity conditional on a supplied optimal coupling. No optimal-plan existence, path continuity, uniqueness, arbitrary-time absolute-value wrapper, Benamou-Brenier formula, full geodesic-space instance, or chapter completion. Relative to Log-Concave Sampling Theorem 1.3.23, this is an explicitly attributed endpoint-domain generalization; its old P2ac theorem remains a corollary.

assumption_deltas.source: mu0 and mu1 belong to W2=P2(R^d)
assumption_deltas.lean: IsProbabilityMeasure mu0 and mu1 plus Integrable (fun x => norm x squared) for both endpoints
assumption_deltas.reason: The source's P2 membership is expanded into probability normalization and finite real second moments. Absolute continuity is absent on both sides.

assumption_deltas.lean: Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space with SecondCountableTopology, StandardBorelSpace and Nonempty
assumption_deltas.reason: The existing ASTIS affine-map, measure-map and exact Wasserstein triangle interfaces use these ambient classes. Every Euclidean R^d source instance satisfies them; no stronger endpoint regularity is introduced.

assumption_deltas.source: gamma is an optimal plan in Gamma(mu0,mu1)
assumption_deltas.reason: The predicate records both marginals and exact attainment of the ENNReal quadratic transport-cost infimum. Existence is an input in this declaration.

assumption_deltas.lean: Explicit hs0, hst and ht1 inequalities and displacementInterpolation gamma r
assumption_deltas.reason: The affine pushforward is definitionally the source path. Ordered times make ofReal(t-s) the exact nonnegative coefficient.

assumption_deltas.lean: An equality in ENNReal, with endpoint finiteness derived before cancellation
assumption_deltas.reason: ASTIS's Wasserstein distance is ENNReal-valued so infinite costs remain representable. The finite-moment hypotheses prove the displayed values are finite; the equality preserves the source constant without totalized real conversion.

assumption_deltas.source: Theorem 7.6 also concludes W2 is a geodesic space and constructs a path for every endpoint pair
assumption_deltas.lean: Only the ordered metric identity for a supplied gamma
assumption_deltas.reason: This binding is intentionally one proof obligation of the source theorem. The existence and packaging obligations remain separately red and are not inferred from the conditional theorem.
